Erasmus+ Online Learning Agreement – Østfold University of Applied Sciences
Erasmus+ Online Learning Agreement
Østfold University of Applied Sciences uses the Online Learning Agreement (OLA). Until further notice, we will continue to accept the paper-version of the Learning Agreement should it not be possible for you to submit an OLA.
How to complete your OLA
You can assess the OLA by logging into this website:
https://www.learning-agreement.eu/
Complete the OLA. Below are some useful tips:

Enter correct academic year (2026/2027)

Make sure the email address for your contact person from your home institution is correct.

Commitment
Make sure that you sign your OLA. It is only when you have signed that the coordinator at your home university will be able to sign it. The signature field works best on touch screen, but you can also sign your OLA using your mouse.
